outcome: maternal complications (HELLP syndrome, Abruptio placentae, PPH, neurological complications, ICU admissions, maternal death)
perinatal complications (stillbirth, NICU admission, low birth weight)
cohort: 5139 pregnant women delivering at a tertiary care hospital in Eastern India between July 2015 and December 2017
finding: Pregnancy-induced hypertension (PIH) affects 6.57% of pregnancies and is associated with increased maternal and perinatal morbidity and mortality, particularly in early-onset disease.
gest_age: Beyond 20 weeks of pregnancy, with early onset defined as before 34 weeks and late onset as term (68.1% of PIH cases).
followup_time: N/A - Study analyzed outcomes related to the delivery/pregnancy, not long term follow up.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was studied as an outcome, but specific weight ranges are not mentioned.
